_README: Web-only UI strings: concepts that exist on a website but not in the Flutter app,
so the .arb files have no approved wording for them (a skip link, a 404 page,
breadcrumbs, 'view all', the note that web review progress does not sync).
Everything the app already names comes from src/lib/i18n/messages/*.json, which is
generated from the app's .arb files by `pnpm i18n:import` — never hand-edited.
This file is the only place new Persian and Kurdish copy is written, kept separate
so it can be reviewed in one sitting. Vocabulary follows the app's own usage:
داگرتن for download, نوێ for new, گەڕانەوە for back, بینین for view.
Erfan: these are the strings to check. If any wording is off, change it here.
